note: Missouri River bottomland of timber, marsh and fields near New Franklin; the island has been joined to the mainland by a levee since 1952. The map marks three primitive camping spots, each beside a parking lot: this pin is a small grassy lot in the woods of the detached east tract off Route 444; the other two (A and D) are 3.5 km west on the main area road, D a gravel lot beside the river boat ramp. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: page 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites'; brochure 'Camping is allowed anytime in designated camping areas shown on map ... No amenities', 14 days in 30; map (11/2023) three Primitive Camping symbols (A, C, D), each beside a lot = GIS 298, 286, 297. All by road (the island was closed off by a levee in 1952). Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights manual. PIN = camp C, fine. SPLIT proposed for the west camps (A/D) at 38.98661,-92.72110. Phone mismatch: page (573) 445-3882 vs stored 573-815-7900.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page 'Things to Do When You Visit': 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites'. Brochure: 'Camping is allowed anytime in designated camping areas shown on map. These may or may not have defined campsites. No amenities are provided. Seasonal closures and restrictions may apply. Groups of more than 10 campers require a special use permit. Campers are limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period.' Map (11/6/2023) legend 'Primitive Camping'; symbols beside lots A, C and D only (lots B and E and the ramp lot carry none). Designated points beside lots: stays. No horse camp, ford or rig wording.

ISLAND ACCESS: road, not boat. The page: 'In 1952, the remnant chute was closed permanently by a flood control levee'; the map shows camps A and D on the MDC improved road in from US 40 ('Franklin Island CA') and camp C on a short drive off Route 444. No camp needs a boat.

CAMPS: C (GIS 286 = the pin, 38.99035,-92.67956) on lot 2656, a grassy clearing ~15 x 40 m in woods in the detached east tract, own entrance off Route 444 - a 23-ft rig fits but the surface is grass/dirt. A (GIS 298, 38.99226,-92.72098) beside lot 1263, a small pull-off on the main area road. D (GIS 297, 38.98655,-92.72152) beside lot 1261, a gravel lot ~40 x 25 m just west of the concrete boat ramp and its own lot (3242); the camping symbol sits by lot D, not the ramp lot, so it is a designated point rather than ramp-lot camping. A and D are 0.6 km apart on one road.

SPLIT PROPOSED: camps A and D (west, entrance from US 40 on the MDC improved road) are 3.5-3.7 km from camp C (east tract, entrance off Route 444) - distinct areas with their own roads. Candidate new entry 'Franklin Island Conservation Area (west)' at lot D 38.98661,-92.72110 (the larger gravel lot; A is 0.6 km N on the same road). near.py: nothing else in campgrounds.json within 3 km of either west camp.

PIN: stored 38.99035,-92.67956 = GIS 286 on lot 2656 (camp C); no change. If AWH would rather the existing entry stand for the west camps (two of the three, by the main entrance), move it to 38.98661,-92.72110 and the split becomes the east tract.
WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): camp C has no water near; camp D is ~90-100 m from the Missouri River across trees and the ramp lot; A has none.
PHONE MISMATCH: area page 'For more information call (573) 445-3882'; stored 573-815-7900 (an MDC regional office number) is not on the page. Not changed (phone is not a schema group here).
Season (manual, year-round) left as stored; brochure 'Seasonal closures and restrictions may apply' (the map's 'Seasonally Opened Road' serves none of the camps).
